title: Reading Drill — A Study of Coffee Cup Returns
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Study of Coffee Cup Returns
passages.body:
**A** A campus café tested a deposit for reusable cups. The team tracked which cups were sent back immediately and which were returned to the other branch on a later day.

**B** Returns fell during a week when one branch had fewer staff. Its deposit desk closed early and students carrying cups could not get a refund before their bus left.

**C** After the trial, the café allowed returns at the ordinary counter. Staff could scan a symbol printed on the cup to confirm that it belonged to the deposit scheme.

questions.prompt: The team tracked which cups were sent back immediately and which were returned to the ______ on a later day.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: The team tracked which cups were sent back immediately and which were returned to the other branch on a later day.

questions.prompt: Its deposit desk closed early and students carrying cups could not get a ______ before their bus left.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Its deposit desk closed early and students carrying cups could not get a refund before their bus left.

questions.prompt: Staff could scan a ______ printed on the cup to confirm that it belonged to the deposit scheme.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Staff could scan a symbol printed on the cup to confirm that it belonged to the deposit scheme.

questions.prompt: The deposit was higher than the cost of a small coffee.
questions.instructions: Does this statement agree with the information in the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage does not state this information.

questions.prompt: Which paragraph mentions the reason a temporary fall in returns was observed?
questions.explanation: Returns fell during a week when one branch had fewer staff. Its deposit desk closed early and students carrying cups could not get a refund before their bus left.
